brief:
A source within the "Peace Council" led by U.S. President Donald Trump characterized paper kites flown by Gaza children as posing minimal risk, according to Shehab Wire. The official said the kites do not represent what he called a "complex challenge" to Israeli security.

The source stated that the kites are not deployed to transport weapons or incendiary materials during incidents. His remarks appeared aimed at downplaying Israeli concerns about the use of such devices in the territory.
